title: Rav Yirmiyah bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Moed Katan 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.9b.19), disputing with Rav Huna bar Chiya about the meaning of “oil of myrrh.” Hyman considers Ami a scribal error and says the name should read Rav Yirmiyah bar Abba, as in [Pesachim 43a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.43a.2) and [Megillah 13a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.13a.18).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Moed Katan gives Huna bar Chiyya and Yirmeyah bar Ami for the two definitions. Pesachim gives Huna bar Yirmeyah and Yirmeyah bar Abba, and Megillah gives Chiyya bar Abba and Rav Huna, respectively.
